title: Turkish-Style Manti
description: A traditional Turkish dish made with homemade dumplings filled with spiced lamb and served with yogurt and garlic sauce.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground lamb, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
In a separate bowl, combine flour and water. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 20-25 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the lamb mixture in the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Gently add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
While the dumplings are cooking, mix together yogurt and garlic sauce in a small bowl.
Serve the cooked dumplings with the yogurt-garlic sauce on top.
